display_name: Rudra Singha & Pramatta Singha of Rang Ghar
one_line: Ahom kings who shaped the royal sports pavilion Rang Ghar at Rupahi Pathar, blending Bihu games, royal spectacle and ingenious brick architecture.

appearance.age_look: Rudra Singha appears in his late 30s with a solid warrior’s build; Pramatta Singha appears in his early 40s with a slightly slimmer, scholar-administrator build.
appearance.face: Both share an oval face with medium-brown Assamese complexion, straight nose and defined jaw; Rudra has a bold, confident default half-smile with sharp eyes and a small healed scar on his left cheek, while Pramatta has a calm, thoughtful expression with slightly softer eyes and faint smile lines.
appearance.hair: Rudra’s hair is straight, thick and black, tied into a high topknot at the back of his head with a red cloth band, the sides neatly combed back; Pramatta’s black hair is slightly shorter, pulled into a lower, tidy knot at the nape, framed by smooth temples, and he wears a simple cream Ahom-style cloth band like a narrow turban wrap around the crown.
appearance.costume: Rudra wears a rich mustard-gold muga silk jama (knee-length fitted angarkha-style tunic) with long sleeves, side tie, and subtle woven floral motifs in a slightly darker gold, over a white cotton dhoti wrapped tightly to the ankles with a broad front pleat; over his shoulder is a cream eri shawl with a red border and small geometric red motifs at the ends; he has a wide brown leather belt, simple gold stud earrings, a single thin gold necklace, and brown leather sandals. Pramatta wears a slightly longer, pale sage-green cotton jama with a soft flare below the waist, fine red piping along the edges and cuffs, over an off-white dhoti of slightly thicker cotton; he drapes a white gamusa with red woven patterns neatly over one shoulder, wears slimmer brown belt, small gold ear-studs, and a modest beaded wrist bracelet; both have era-appropriate modest coverage, with tunics fully covering the torso and arms, and dhotis covering the legs to the ankles.
appearance.signature: Rudra carries a sheathed curved sword (dao) with a polished steel hilt and plain wooden scabbard, worn at his left hip, while Pramatta holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with red thread in one hand and a small clay model of the boat-shaped Rang Ghar roof in the other arm when posed together.

ref_desc: Rudra Singha and Pramatta Singha are medium-brown Assamese Ahom kings with black hair in cloth-tied knots, wearing mustard-gold and sage-green knee-length jamas over white dhotis with cream/red shawls, Rudra bearing a sheathed curved dao and Pramatta holding a manuscript and small clay Rang Ghar roof model, in a mustard-gold, sage-green, cream, white and brick-red palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two Ahom kings from 17th–18th century Assam standing side by side at Rupahi Pathar near a distant brick pavilion, both fully and modestly clothed in era-accurate garments. The first, Rudra Singha, has an athletic build, medium-brown Assamese complexion, oval face, sharp eyes, a tiny healed scar on his left cheek and a confident half-smile. His straight black hair is tied into a high topknot at the back of his head with a red cloth band, sides combed back neatly. He wears a rich mustard-gold muga silk knee-length jama (fitted angarkha-style tunic) with long sleeves and subtle darker-gold woven floral motifs, tied at the side, over a tightly wrapped white cotton dhoti reaching his ankles with a broad front pleat. A cream eri shawl with a red border and small geometric red motifs is draped over one shoulder, and a wide brown leather belt encircles his waist. He has simple gold stud earrings, a thin gold necklace and brown leather sandals, and at his left hip hangs his signature sheathed curved dao with polished steel hilt and plain wooden scabbard. The second, Pramatta Singha, stands slightly behind and to the side, with a medium-brown Assamese complexion, oval face, softer thoughtful eyes and calm expression with faint smile lines. His straight black hair is pulled into a lower, tidy knot at the nape and he wears a simple cream cloth band like a narrow turban wrap around the crown. He wears a slightly longer pale sage-green cotton jama with a gentle flare below the waist, long sleeves and fine red piping along edges and cuffs, over an off-white dhoti of thicker cotton reaching the ankles. A white gamusa with red woven patterns is draped neatly over one shoulder; he has a slim brown belt, small gold ear-studs, a modest beaded wrist bracelet and simple sandals. In his hands he holds his signature objects: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with red thread and a small clay model of the boat-shaped Rang Ghar roof, hinting at royal sports architecture and adaptive brick craft. Emphasize consistent facial features, hair knots and clothing details, and keep the color palette focused on mustard gold, sage green, cream, white and brick red tones for a coherent, historically grounded yet energetic shonen-anime look.
